## Purpose

Describe the change and link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] Installed `requirements-dev.txt` in a virtual environment
- [ ] Ran `python -m pytest` using that environment's interpreter
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests updated
- [ ] No secrets, environment files, virtual environments, or caches included

For startup or routing changes, describe the endpoint checks performed.
For deployment changes, distinguish local validation from live Builder results.

## Breaking changes

Describe any changed endpoints, environment variables, or deployment behavior.
